answer_1.quote: Generating a response given the conversation history can be formulated as a sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) learning problem, where we use the Transformer architecture to perform this task.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the trained models using automatic metrics including perplexity, NIST-n, BLEU-n, METEOR, Entropy-n, and Dist-n.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 100 dialog examples and ask 5 undergraduate and graduate students to rate the generated responses in terms of informativeness, relevance, and human-likeness.
answer_4.guideline: Ratings on informativeness, relevance, and human-likeness from 1 to 5.
